claims.text: Nonprofit (501(c)(3)) hospital must have a written FAP and a written emergency medical care policy
claims.quote: establishes for that hospital facility— (1) A written financial assistance policy (FAP) that meets the requirements of paragraph (b) of this section; and (2) A written emergency medical care policy

claims.text: FAP must apply to emergency and other medically necessary care
claims.quote: Apply to all emergency and other medically necessary care provided by the hospital facility

claims.text: FAP must set out eligibility criteria and whether help includes free or discounted care (who qualifies for free or discounted care; FAQ difference between charity care and payment plan)
claims.quote: The eligibility criteria for financial assistance and whether such assistance includes free or discounted care;

claims.text: FAP must state the basis used to calculate amounts charged to patients
claims.quote: The basis for calculating amounts charged to patients;

claims.text: FAP must explain how to apply (FAQ: eligibility criteria and application method)
claims.quote: The method for applying for financial assistance;

claims.text: FAP must be widely publicized; covered hospitals must widely publicize their FAPs; required to maintain and publicize
claims.quote: Be widely publicized as described in paragraph (b)(5) of this section

claims.text: Federal law requires each covered hospital to publish its own eligibility criteria; no single national income cutoff (inference from hospital-specific criteria requirement)
claims.quote: The eligibility criteria that an individual must satisfy to receive each discount, free care, or other level of assistance available under the FAP.

claims.text: The hospital may accept other evidence of eligibility, or your signed statement, if you lack a listed document
claims.quote: may, for example, rely on other evidence of eligibility or an attestation by the applicant to determine that the applicant is FAP-eligible

claims.text: Figure caption: federal 501(r) sets no national threshold; each hospital publishes its own criteria
claims.quote: The eligibility criteria that an individual must satisfy to receive each discount, free care, or other level of assistance available under the FAP.

claims.text: Hospital must make reasonable efforts to determine FAP eligibility before extraordinary collection actions
claims.quote: does not engage in extraordinary collection actions (ECAs) ... against an individual to obtain payment for care before the hospital facility has made reasonable efforts to determine whether the individual is eligible for assistance

claims.text: ECAs include selling debt and adverse credit reporting
claims.quote: (i) Selling an individual's debt to another party ... (ii) Reporting adverse information about the individual to consumer credit reporting agencies or credit bureaus.

claims.text: ECAs include withholding medically necessary care because of unpaid earlier bills
claims.quote: Deferring or denying, or requiring a payment before providing, medically necessary care because of an individual's nonpayment of one or more bills for previously provided care

claims.text: ECAs include legal actions such as liens and wage garnishment
claims.quote: Actions that require a legal or judicial process, including but not limited to— (A) Placing a lien on an individual's property ... (G) Garnishing an individual's wages.

claims.text: Presumptive eligibility: decision based on information other than what the person provided, or on an earlier eligibility decision
claims.quote: if it determines that the individual is FAP-eligible for the care based on information other than that provided by the individual or based on a prior FAP-eligibility determination
